reviews.title: Advertisements
reviews.text: Excellent app with all the features I need, but the number of ads has become ridiculous. It used to be just one 5-second ad, but now there are two ads, and they’re much longer. I shouldn’t have to sit through 15–20 seconds of advertisements just to check prayer times. I understand the need for ads, but this is excessive and really hurts the user experience. If this continues, I’ll unfortunately have to switch to another prayer time app. I hope the developers reconsider this change before they lose more users.

reviews.title: Please fix errors in hadith and ayah wording
reviews.text: Assalamu alaikum. I like the idea of this app, but I noticed a serious issue with the daily hadith and daily verse. The wording is mixed up and not translated properly, and in some places it changes the meaning. These are not small mistakes as accuracy is very important when it comes to Qur’an and hadith. Please review and fix these errors as soon as possible. Jazka'Allahu Khair.
